historical_population.name: Population · historical estimate
historical_population.definition: Total population, converted from source thousands of inhabitants to people (×1,000). Benchmark estimates; between compatible benchmarks the Atlas may interpolate over at most 20 years.
historical_population.caveat: Modern 2012 reference-country geography from Clio Infra, not a match to historical borders. Source mixes statistical reports and historical reconstructions; per-row uncertainty is not supplied. Published estimates, not independently verified measurements.

historical_life.name: Life expectancy · historical estimate
historical_life.definition: Period life expectancy at birth, both sexes. Compiled historical reconstruction; a benchmark is not automatically a decade average. Source combines annual and multi-year estimates; original source-year labels are retained.
historical_life.caveat: Modern 2012 reference-country geography from Clio Infra, not a match to historical borders. Source mixes statistical reports and historical reconstructions; per-row uncertainty is not supplied. Published estimates, not independently verified measurements.

historical_urbanization.name: Urban population share · historical
historical_urbanization.definition: Urban population divided by total population. Source fraction converted to percent (×100). Urban definitions vary by source; benchmark years only, without interpolation.
historical_urbanization.caveat: Modern 2012 reference-country geography from Clio Infra, not a match to historical borders. Source mixes statistical reports and historical reconstructions; per-row uncertainty is not supplied. Published estimates, not independently verified measurements.

historical_height.name: Adult male-equivalent height · birth decade
historical_height.definition: Average adult male-equivalent height of the cohort BORN in the source decade. Not average height of people living in the selected year. Published sample reconstructions and corrections; held constant only within the stated birth decade.
historical_height.caveat: Modern 2012 reference-country geography from Clio Infra, not a match to historical borders. Source mixes statistical reports and historical reconstructions; per-row uncertainty is not supplied. Published estimates, not independently verified measurements.

historical_illiteracy_15_br.name: Illiteracy · census (15+)
historical_illiteracy_15_br.definition: Published census illiteracy rate among people aged 15 and older. Tabela 2, printed page 6 / PDF page 8. Source: IBGE Censo Demográfico. Basic reading and writing, not functional literacy.
historical_illiteracy_15_br.caveat: Country-level census geography; no automatic match to historical borders. Age thresholds and census definitions must be respected. No interpolation is applied.
